verses.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by God's will, to God's holy people in Ephesus, the faithful in Christ Jesus:
Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In Christ, he has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in heaven.
Before the world began, he chose us in Christ to be holy and blameless before him, living in love.
God decided in advance to adopt us as his children through Jesus Christ. This pleased him and was what he wanted.
So we praise the glory of his grace, which he freely gave us in the one he loves.
Through Christ's blood we are set free, and our sins are forgiven, in keeping with the riches of God's grace.
He poured that grace out on us, along with all wisdom and understanding.
God made known to us the mystery of his will, in line with his good purpose, which he planned in Christ:
to bring everything together under Christ when the right time comes—everything in heaven and on earth.
In Christ we were also chosen to receive an inheritance, as God had planned in advance, since he carries out everything according to his will.
His purpose was that we, who were the first to put our hope in Christ, would live to praise his glory.
You also heard the true message, the Good News that saves you, and believed in Christ. Then God marked you as his own by giving you the promised Holy Spirit.
The Spirit is the guarantee of our inheritance until God redeems his own people, to the praise of his glory.
That's why, since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people,
I haven't stopped thanking God for you and remembering you in my prayers.
I pray that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, will give you the Spirit of wisdom and revelation so you can know him better.
I pray that the eyes of your heart will be enlightened, so you'll know the hope of his calling, the riches of his glorious inheritance among his people,
and the immeasurable greatness of his power toward us who believe. That power works with the same mighty strength
God used in Christ when he raised him from the dead and seated him at his right hand in the heavenly realms,
far above every ruler, authority, power, and lord, and every name that can be named—not only in this age but also in the age to come.
God placed everything under Christ's feet and appointed him as head over everything for the church,
which is his body, the fullness of the one who fills everything in every way.
You were dead because of your trespasses and sins, but God made you alive.
At one time you lived the way this world lives, following the ruler of the power of the air—the spirit now at work in those who disobey.
We all once lived among them, following the desires of our human nature and thoughts. Like everyone else, we were headed for God's anger.
But God is rich in mercy, and because he loved us so deeply,
he made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. You have been saved by grace!
God raised us up with Christ and seated us with him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,
so that in the ages to come he could show the immeasurable riches of his grace through his kindness to us in Christ Jesus.
You have been saved by grace through faith. This isn't from yourselves; it's God's gift.
It doesn't come from works, so no one can brag.
We are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to live out.
So remember that you Gentiles by birth were called ‘the uncircumcised’ by those called ‘the circumcised’—a physical mark made by human hands.
At that time you were apart from Christ, excluded from Israel's citizenship, strangers to the covenants of promise, without hope and without God in the world.
But now in Christ Jesus, you who once were far away have been brought near through Christ's blood.
Christ himself is our peace. He made the two groups one and broke down the dividing wall of hostility,
by setting aside in his body the law with its commands and regulations. His purpose was to create one new humanity from the two groups, making peace,
and to reconcile both to God in one body through the cross, putting the hostility to death there.
He came and announced peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.
Through him, both groups have access to the Father by one Spirit.
So you are no longer foreigners or outsiders. You are fellow citizens with God's people and members of God's household.
You are built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus himself as the cornerstone.
In him, the whole building is joined together and grows into a holy temple in the Lord.
And in him, you too are being built together into a home where God lives by his Spirit.
For this reason, I, Paul, am a prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles.
Surely you've heard that God gave me this responsibility to share his grace with you.
God revealed the mystery to me, as I wrote briefly before.
When you read this, you'll understand my insight into the mystery of Christ.
People in earlier generations weren't told this mystery, but now the Spirit has revealed it to God's holy apostles and prophets.
The mystery is this: through the Good News, the Gentiles share the same inheritance, belong to the same body, and share in the promise in Christ Jesus.
I became a servant of this Good News through God's gift of grace, given to me by the working of his power.
Though I'm less than the least of all God's people, this grace was given to me: to announce to the Gentiles Christ's immeasurable riches,
and to make clear to everyone how God is carrying out the mystery that was hidden for ages in God, who created everything.
God's purpose was that now, through the church, his many-sided wisdom would be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,
according to his eternal purpose, which he carried out in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Through faith in Christ, we can approach God with freedom and confidence.
So I ask you not to lose heart because of my troubles for you. They are for your glory.
That's why I kneel before the Father,
from whom every family in heaven and on earth gets its name.
I pray that from the riches of his glory he will strengthen you with power through his Spirit in your inner being,
so that Christ may live in your hearts through faith. And I pray that you will be rooted and grounded in love,
so you can grasp, together with all God's people, how wide, long, high, and deep Christ's love is,
and know this love that goes beyond knowledge, so you may be filled with all God's fullness.
To the one who can do far beyond anything we ask or imagine, through the power working in us,
to him be glory in the church and in Christ Jesus through every generation, forever and ever. Amen.
So I, a prisoner in the Lord, urge you to live in a way worthy of the calling you received.
Be humble and gentle, patient, and put up with one another in love.
Make every effort to preserve the unity the Spirit gives, held together by peace.
There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope.
There is one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
one God and Father of all, who is over all, works through all, and lives in all.
But each of us has received grace according to the measure Christ has given.
That's why Scripture says, ‘When he went up on high, he led captives in his train and gave gifts to people.’
What does ‘he went up’ mean except that he also came down to the lower regions of the earth?
The one who came down is also the one who went up far above all the heavens, so he could fill everything.
Christ gave some to be apostles, some prophets, some evangelists, and some pastors and teachers,
to equip God's people for serving and to build up Christ's body,
until we all reach unity in faith and in knowing God's Son, becoming mature and reaching the full measure of Christ.
Then we won't be children anymore, tossed around by waves and carried here and there by every new teaching, tricked by people and their schemes.
Instead, speaking the truth in love, we'll grow in every way into Christ, who is the head.
From him the whole body is joined and held together by every supporting ligament. As each part does its work, the body grows and builds itself up in love.
So I tell you this, and insist on it in the Lord: don't live anymore as the Gentiles do, with their empty thinking.
Their understanding is darkened. They are separated from God's life because of the ignorance in them and the hardening of their hearts.
They've become numb and given themselves over to reckless behavior, pursuing every kind of impurity and greed.
But that's not how you learned Christ,
if indeed you heard about him and were taught in him, as the truth is in Jesus.
You were taught to take off your old self, which belongs to your former way of life and is being ruined by deceptive desires,
to be renewed in the spirit of your minds,
and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
So stop lying. Each of you should tell the truth to your neighbor, because we're all parts of one another.
‘Be angry, but don't sin.’ Don't let the sun go down while you're still angry,
and don't give the devil an opening.
If you used to steal, stop stealing. Instead, work hard and do something useful with your hands, so you can share with anyone in need.
Don't let harmful talk come out of your mouth. Say only what is helpful for building others up, as the moment calls for, so your words can give grace to those who hear.
Don't grieve God's Holy Spirit, who marked you as his own for the day of redemption.
Get rid of all bitterness, rage, anger, shouting, slander, and every kind of malice.
Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other just as God forgave you in Christ.
So imitate God, as his dearly loved children.
Live in love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself for us as an offering and sacrifice to God, a pleasing aroma.
Among you, God's holy people, there shouldn't even be a hint of sexual immorality, impurity, or greed.
Don't use obscene language, foolish talk, or crude jokes. Instead, give thanks.
Be sure of this: no sexually immoral or impure person, and no greedy person (who is an idol worshiper), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.
Don't let anyone deceive you with empty arguments. These are the things that bring God's anger on those who disobey.
So don't join in with them.
Once you were darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Live as children of light,
whose fruit is every kind of goodness, righteousness, and truth.
Find out what pleases the Lord.
Don't take part in the fruitless works of darkness. Instead, expose them.
It's shameful even to talk about the secret things people do.
But when anything is exposed by the light, it becomes visible,
because everything that becomes visible is light. That's why Scripture says, ‘Wake up, sleeper! Rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.’
So pay close attention to how you live—not like foolish people, but like wise people.
Make the most of every opportunity, because these are evil days.
Don't be foolish. Understand what the Lord wants.
Don't get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless living. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
Encourage one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your heart to the Lord.
Always give thanks to God the Father for everything, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
Wives, submit to your own husbands as you do to the Lord.
The husband is the head of the wife, just as Christ is the head of the church—his body, of which he is the Savior.
Just as the church submits to Christ, wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her
to make her holy, cleansing her by washing with water through the word,
and to present her to himself as a glorious church, without stain, wrinkle, or anything like that, but holy and blameless.
In the same way, husbands should love their wives as their own bodies. Whoever loves his wife loves himself.
No one ever hated their own body. Instead, they feed and care for it, just as Christ does for the church,
because we are parts of his body.
Scripture says, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united with his wife, and the two will become one flesh.’
This mystery is profound, and I'm talking about Christ and the church.
However, each of you must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife should respect her husband.
Children, obey your parents in the Lord, because this is right.
Scripture says, ‘Honor your father and mother.’ This is the first command with a promise:
‘so that things may go well for you and you may live long on the earth.’
Parents, don't provoke your children to anger. Bring them up with the Lord's discipline and instruction.
Enslaved people, obey your earthly masters with respect and sincerity, as you would Christ.
Don't work only when someone is watching, just to please people. As Christ's servants, do God's will from your heart.
Serve willingly, as if you were serving the Lord and not people,
because you know that the Lord will reward each person for whatever good they do, whether enslaved or free.
Masters, treat them the same way. Stop threatening them. Remember that both they and you have the same Master in heaven, and he shows no favoritism.
Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.
Put on all of God's armor so you can stand against the devil's schemes.
Our struggle isn't against people, but against rulers, authorities, the powers of this dark world, and spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
So put on all of God's armor, so that when the evil day comes, you can stand your ground, and after you've done everything, still stand.
Stand firm, with truth buckled around your waist and righteousness as your armor,
and with your feet ready to share the Good News of peace.
Most of all, take up the shield of faith, which can put out all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is God's word.
Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and request. Stay alert and keep praying for all God's people.
Pray for me too, that whenever I speak, God will give me the right words to boldly make known the mystery of the Good News,
for which I'm an ambassador in chains. Pray that I'll speak boldly about it, as I should.
Tychicus, our dear brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything about how I'm doing.
I sent him to you for this very reason: so you'll know how we're doing and he'll encourage your hearts.
Peace to the brothers and sisters, and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with undying love. Amen.
